subject: AI Data Leaders Dinner Invite - London
text:
Hi [NAME],

My colleagues & I were in touch with [SENDER] & Svebor on your team some time
ago who mentioned that you were based out of London, so thought I'd reach
out. Our CEO, [SENDER] is co-hosting an intimate gathering of Human
Data Leaders with Prolific on Thursday, May 29th, and we'd love for you to
join us, if you're available.

The event will run from 6:00 - 9:00 PM, and will include guests and experts
from leading AI labs and companies including OpenAI, Cohere, Synthesia &
Microsoft.

frontiers of human data and best practices in building human-in-the-loop
workflows. Following the panel, we'll move into a roundtable dinner with a
more informal setting for the conversation to continue.

Please let me know if you're interested in joining us for dinner.
